title: Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1966-11-29

ai_review.summary: Rough but lively soundboard capture of a November 1966 Matrix show featuring rare early‑Dead cuts like Viola Lee Blues and Same Thing.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with a handful of seldom‑heard numbers – Viola Lee Blues, Same Thing, Big Boy Pete, Been Down So Long and others – and even a bebop‑flavored drum intro from Bill Kreutzmann.  The soundboard recording is far from pristine; listeners note channel drop‑outs and overall muddiness, yet the energy of this early Dead set still comes through.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers award 5 stars for the show’s rarity and performance; recording issues are noted but do not outweigh the musical strengths, yielding a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not a perfect capture – occasional right‑channel drop‑out on Viola Lee Blues and general murkiness typical of early recordings – but still listenable and representative of the era.

standout_songs: I Just Want To Make Love To You
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set opens with a bebop‑tinged drum intro, rolls through rare blues/folk covers, and closes with an energetic jam that caps the night.

band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann starts the show with a bebop‑style drum figure, noted as a highlight by reviewers.
